material_findings.status: addressed_in_proposal_json_discussion_r5; parent companion regeneration and review pending
material_findings.issue: Claim submission, insurer receipt of the last necessary document, hospitalization notice and actual claim payment are distinct events. PolicyEvent is contract-only and its narrow kind enum lacks these claim/document/payment events; Claim.submitted_at cannot retain multiple requests, receipts, completion disputes or corrections. Private FactAssertion lacks a claim subject, so a date value alone cannot bind these facts to the correct concurrent claim.
material_findings.required_proposal_change: An owner-bound claim event/document-receipt/payment representation with exact claim, actor/recipient, event time versus recorded time, evidence, necessity/completeness, correction history and separate payment identity. Deadline/interest inputs must resolve to these records and preserve missing rate/day-count/rounding authority.

material_findings.status: addressed_in_proposal_json_discussion_r5; parent companion regeneration and review pending
material_findings.source_note: Annexure C exact IDs must be taken from the source inventory; the issue is numbered source occurrences 181–183 and the inventories’ explicit provisional segmentation protocol.
material_findings.issue: Both completed page readings retain candidate source assertions and explicitly leave the final denominator unmeasured pending atomic segmentation and hierarchy adjudication. RuleInventoryItem is mutable-status single-document/key with positive weight; CoverageReport.inventory_revision is an unbound string. No immutable membership or split/merge lineage fixes which accepted instances constituted a historical denominator, and Rule.inventory_item_id alone cannot map one supported rule to multiple independent source instances.
material_findings.required_proposal_change: Immutable inventory revisions and explicit per-revision memberships, stable source occurrence identity, adjudicated candidate split/merge/hierarchy lineage and rule-to-member support mappings. Coverage reports must bind the exact sealed membership revision, with denominator unknown until closure and segmentation are resolved.

covered_requirements: Conditional benefit grants, failed eligibility predicates, exceptions, unresolved precedence and alternative deduction orders use Rule/RuleDependency/RuleIssue.
Modern configuration cells and footnotes use RuleTable/RuleTableCell; missing CB discount grid remains unknown rather than interpolated.

Insurer-independent dated regulatory rates can be represented by general original-backed Rule definitions with applicability and evidence; they must not be fabricated as hospital observations.
Nominee selection can use owner-bound contract facts referencing Person, original accepted endorsement evidence and effective intervals; an explicit worked mapping is still desirable.
